claims.text: The datasets used are the LibriSpeech corpus and the GlobalPhone corpus.
LibriSpeech corpus contains 960 hours of English audio data, while GlobalPhone corpus includes French, German, Czech, and Spanish.
20 thousand segments from each language in the GlobalPhone corpus were used for calculating average cosine similarity.
